activation.T0: First official 15-minute open strictly after separately reviewed qualified capture activation; never backdate. This is a new sprint T0, not activation of the frozen 56-day reference.
gates: passive producers for required lane conclusions
official contract catalog and outcome path
activation.late_capture: Freeze/deadline do not slide. If capture qualifies after freeze, use unchanged reviewed baseline or PASS-only policy frozen by that point. Fewer forward contracts lower evidence confidence; technical unavailability is reported explicitly.
activation.approval: No paid resource provisioned before exact configuration/cost/rollback approval; no production deployment in this mission.

stages.end_rule: As soon as deterministic controls and short hosted nonproduction smoke pass; parallel with historical development
stages.purpose: Engineering/capture qualification; synthetic injections are test evidence, never live clock or market witnesses
Historical causal replay and qualified live development only; all lanes in parallel; no reused historically inspected row is forward confirmation
Freeze exact policy, extraction, feature, interpretation, dashboard, scorer and hypothesis/selection manifest hashes before the first forward contract opens; freeze earlier if ready

stages.start_rule: Official contract open at actual frozen boundary, no later than 2026-10-01T19:00:00Z
stages.purpose: Sealed forward confirmation; no strategy tuning or development access to outcomes; publish finish-line classification by mandate deadline

partition_rules.membership: One entire official contract and all its origins/events stay in the partition selected by official open. Development observations or origins never cross into forward confirmation.
partition_rules.seal: Before first forward open: save signed/hash-bound freeze/partition manifest; enforce outcome access separation. Collector archives bytes; developer does not inspect forward outcomes until final unlock. Operational alerts remain visible without outcome labels.
partition_rules.seal_failure: Preserve and label affected block PREVIOUSLY_INSPECTED; never relabel as unseen confirmation. Remaining future block may remain sealed with its original boundary. Deadline unchanged.
partition_rules.post_freeze_fix: A required safety/capture repair creates a new build/run epoch and explicit evidence discontinuity. Do not pool it as the original frozen candidate; finish with honest limited/unavailable classification. No tuned strategy update during confirmation.
partition_rules.minimums: No outcome-adaptive signal/contract floor reduction, extension, retrospective repartition or replacement. There is no mandatory 30-56 day development duration.
partition_rules.development_budget: At most three newly preregistered interpretable hypotheses per lane, all hypotheses reported. Require genuinely richer causally qualified evidence. The eight rejected EARLY recorded-feature rules remain negative controls, not a renewed search family. No threshold sweep.
partition_rules.selection: One deterministic development-only candidate per lane, or PASS-only. Its evidence needs, costs, selection rule, no-edge behavior and exact parameters are frozen before forward outcomes. This infrastructure package selects no new strategy.

lane_scoring.EARLY: Report first genuine immutable origin per contract; <=50c and ideal 25-35c ASK strata; authoritative settled correctness, coverage over official catalog, timing, PASS/UNAVAILABLE and failure clusters. No accepted origin fabricated from research proposal or quote touch.
lane_scoring.FINAL: Confirmation/protection only, linked to immutable actual or explicitly research-only EARLY. Opposing ready=false and qualified opposing ready=true are separate. HOLD/weakening/PROTECT timing and recovery require genuine continuous evidence. Disagreement alone cannot EXIT.
lane_scoring.SCALP: Published entry and executable original/first post-publication ASK remain separate. Require strict later same-side BID and full observed path; target-first/stop-first within gaps unavailable. Preserve policy, serial ownership and genuine V8.1 transitions. Older shadow results are separate descriptive baseline.

completeness.catalog: Account for every official scheduled eligible contract, including unknown/missing/WAIT/quiet; unknown catalog coverage blocks coverage claims.
completeness.individual: All required origin/linkage/source/clock/quote/continuity/settlement witnesses genuine, causal and immutable as required. Otherwise UNAVAILABLE, retained in denominator.
completeness.reason: Preserve frozen 99% observation/origin completeness criterion for general lane conclusions; lower completeness means limited/unavailable evidence, never a silently reduced gate or shifted sample.
completeness.source_clock: No receipt-time substitution, synthetic source witness, BRTI-age-derived timestamp, or clock certificate without measured and justified premises. BRTI <=5s and native cadence remain unchanged.

uncertainty.binary: 95% Wilson intervals for unique-contract proportions. Publish n, correct/incorrect, exact days, exclusions, missingness worst/best bounds and price/timing strata.
uncertainty.signals: 2000-replicate contract-cluster bootstrap, seed 20260929, for origin/signal statistics; keep all a contract's records together.
uncertainty.dependence: Report day-block sensitivity; fewer than three distinct days has unavailable day sensitivity. No seven-day sample proves permanent 90-95% population accuracy.
uncertainty.descriptive_floor: Below 30 relevant unique contracts, report exact counts and wide intervals; label LIMITED SAMPLE and do not infer subgroup differences.
uncertainty.qualified_starting_early: Requires all technical gates, complete sealed evidence, >=30 unique forward signal contracts over >=3 distinct days, forward observed correctness >=85%, Wilson lower >=85%, <=50c admitted ASK and no demonstrated incompatible failure cluster; still only a starting configuration, never permanent population proof. Below this predeclared standard may be PROMISING/LIMITED or PASS-only.
uncertainty.qualified_starting_final_scalp: Technical qualification plus separately preregistered development-selected causal policy-specific acceptance criteria fixed before freeze; none are invented from shadow profits or a post-hoc best matrix cell. If no such candidate/evidence exists, classify limited/PASS-only/unavailable.
uncertainty.no_calendar_extension: Statistical imprecision alone never extends the completion deadline; the finished signal-only dashboard can show PASS/UNAVAILABLE lanes while monitoring continues.

current_lane_status.EARLY: PASS-ONLY / INSUFFICIENT EDGE: recorded-feature Round-1 family failed; no new selected richer candidate yet.
current_lane_status.FINAL: UNAVAILABLE — SPECIFIC TECHNICAL FAILURE for prospective protection inference until genuine protected trajectory, immutable origin/linkage and clocks are captured.
current_lane_status.SCALP: UNAVAILABLE — SPECIFIC TECHNICAL FAILURE for current V8.1 prospective qualification: genuine admitted entry/quote/transition evidence absent. Historical true-SCALP research baseline remains promising separately; zero new qualified prospective V8.1 results.

monitoring.operation: Detect -> classify -> local alert outbox -> preserve evidence. No automatic strategy changes or orders. External delivery wiring requires reviewed deployment.
monitoring.system: All required witnessed checks pass => HEALTHY; warning margin => WATCH; evidenced incompatible change => DRIFT; missing/failed/future/expired check => UNAVAILABLE.
monitoring.performance: Rolling descriptive summaries; performance alarms only at fixed nonoverlapping 7-day checkpoints anchored to reviewed live-monitoring T0, >=100 unique relevant contracts across >=7 days. These are monitoring sufficiency gates, not sprint completion floors.
monitoring.alpha_spending: Conditional heuristic one-sided Hoeffding screen at checkpoint k uses alpha=0.05/[3*k*(k+1)]. Its nominal <=5% total error bound requires independent/conditional Bernoulli premises, which market records do not establish. Do not claim controlled false-positive rate under unverified serial dependence. FINAL/SCALP have no unearned numerical floor.
monitoring.no_tiny_sample_drift: Insufficient contracts/days or absent policy baseline => WATCH/LIMITED SAMPLE, never statistical DRIFT. Technical faults remain immediate independent of sample size.
